cycles.reason: Legacy shared service contracts create a type-only back-edge between subscription and live monitoring.
cycles.remediation: Extract live-tick and cached-trade projection contracts into a neutral lower-level type module.

cycles.reason: Trade-event delivery depends on the event record contract owned by the service that constructs delivery.
cycles.remediation: Move the trade-event record contract to a neutral monitoring type module and inject the delivery port.

cycles.reason: Legacy live-monitoring, event-delivery, and WebSocket services construct and call one another at runtime.
cycles.remediation: Introduce narrow injected delivery and live-monitoring ports at the application composition boundary.

cycles.reason: The legacy subscription path participates in the runtime live-monitoring, delivery, and WebSocket service cluster.
cycles.remediation: Compose subscription, monitoring, and delivery services through lower-level ports instead of cross-imported singletons.

cycles.reason: The subscription service consumes an active-trade record type from the service that calls subscription behavior.
cycles.remediation: Extract the active-trade record projection into a neutral trade contract module.

cycles.reason: The evaluator implementation imports registry-owned evaluator contracts while the registry imports the evaluator collection.
cycles.remediation: Move evaluator interfaces into a neutral scoring contract module without changing authoritative scoring semantics.
